commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Alysson (Aston Villa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90+4' Aston Villa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Olivier Boscagli (Brighton) took the corner.
90+2' Emiliano Martinez leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Pascal Gross (Brighton). Now Brighton have a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
86' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is about to take a corner kick.
86' 1 - 0 Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) attempts to head the ball away from inside the six-yard box, but unluckily he turns a cross from the resulting corner inside the left post of his own net.
85' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Aston Villa earn a corner.
84' Pascal Gross (Brighton) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

84' Harry Howell (Brighton) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Douglas Luiz trots off the pitch and is replaced by Victor Lindelof (Aston Villa).
84' Pascal Gross (Brighton) serves up a nice cross, but Emiliano Martinez punches the ball away.
81' Substitution. Danny Welbeck makes his way off the pitch and Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton) comes on as his replacement.
81' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to substitute Diego Gomez and he is replaced by Harry Howell (Brighton).
81' That will be all from Kaoru Mitoma who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Yankuba Minteh (Brighton).
80' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Pascal Gross (Brighton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

79' James Milner (Brighton) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards right side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Emiliano Martinez pulls off an easy save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brighton.
75' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Tammy Abraham (Aston Villa) replaces Amadou Onana.
74' That's the end of the game for Ollie Watkins, who is replaced by Alysson (Aston Villa).
73' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
72' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
72' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) and Morgan Rogers attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
71' The attendance for today's match is 39495.
71' Dangerous play by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa). Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.

69' James Milner (Brighton) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot low towards the middle of the net is denied by Emiliano Martinez. This effort didn't really trouble him.
67' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
66' Pascal Gross (Brighton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
65' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
65' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
64' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
64' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Pascal Gross, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Olivier Boscagli (Brighton) is coming onto the pitch as Jan Paul van Hecke cannot continue after picking up an injury.
61' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
60' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) replacing Emiliano Buendia.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch so that Jadon Sancho can be given a rest.
60' Joel Veltman (Brighton) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
59' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts the ball.
58' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
55' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) latches on to a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a brilliant shot towards the goal, but he hits the crossbar!
52' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
50' A yellow-coloured card is received by Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa).
50' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
48' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.

45' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
44' The ball is cleared after Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
43' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
41' The referee shows a yellow card to Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
41' The referee can't ignore those comments and Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) sees a yellow card for bad language.
39' Emiliano Martinez leaps to intercept the corner kick from Pascal Gross (Brighton).

39' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Pascal Gross (Brighton), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brighton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
38' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) brings an opponent down and Peter Bankes interrupts the game.
35' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
33' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) plays a one-two with Jadon Sancho, but the move breaks down.
32' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes the corner with a short pass.

31' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' James Milner (Brighton) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
29' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
28' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
27' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Pascal Gross (Brighton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
26' James Milner (Brighton) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
23' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Joel Veltman (Brighton) for his blatant foul.
23' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
23' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
22' James Milner (Brighton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Carlos Baleba.

20' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Bart Verbruggen guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
20' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
19' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
17' Diego Gomez (Brighton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emiliano Martinez, who smothers the ball.
17' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
15' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) darts into the middle of the box to meet a lofted ball in from Ian Maatsen, but the ball just glances off his head and flies well wide of the right post.
15' Pascal Gross (Brighton) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
10' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

10' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa). Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
9' Diego Gomez (Brighton) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
8' The resulting corner from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) comes to nothing.

8' Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
7' Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
5' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton), but the defence gets it clear.
2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Carlos Baleba (Brighton) was quite harsh and Peter Bankes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
2' Diego Gomez (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
